constraints.summary: Bring up secondary DC control-plane services before cutting over API
constraints.scope: Control plane and analytics services in the secondary datacenter
constraints.rollback: Redeploy the control-plane services back to PDX-01 and restore prior routing

constraints.summary: Keep API contracts backward-compatible during the failover window
constraints.scope: Dashboard API, public API, terraform-provider, and analytics query endpoints
constraints.rollback: Redeploy previous API version that accepts the pre-failover request/response shapes

constraints.summary: Do not switch traffic until code, config, and storage consumers are live
constraints.scope: Any service that reads analytics or configuration state in the secondary DC
constraints.rollback: Revert routing to PDX-01 and redeploy previous binaries in the secondary DC

constraints.summary: Maintain dual-write for config and analytics state during cutover
constraints.scope: Configuration writes and analytics ingestion while both DCs may be active
constraints.rollback: Stop secondary writes and resume single-writer mode in PDX-01

constraints.summary: Keep PDX-01 as writer until secondary confirms it can serve reads/writes
constraints.scope: Datastore and service deployments for control-plane state
constraints.rollback: Fail back writer role to PDX-01 and disable secondary write traffic

constraints.summary: Fail over replication before cutover; no analytics data loss
constraints.scope: Analytics ingestion/query datastores and their cross-DC replication state
constraints.rollback: Repoint analytics services back to PDX-01 primary and resume from the preserved lagging replica

constraints.summary: Keep backfill or rebuild batches within IOPS budget
constraints.scope: Any datastore reseed, replay, or backfill needed in the secondary DC
constraints.rollback: Pause backfill jobs and revert to pre-failover replica state

constraints.summary: Do not drop old primary-side tables until quiet period passes
constraints.scope: Decommissioning PDX-01-only storage objects after failover
constraints.rollback: Retain old tables/volumes and re-enable access if rollback is needed

constraints.summary: Freeze schema changes on migrated datastores during failover
constraints.scope: Schemas for control-plane and analytics databases being moved to secondary DC
constraints.rollback: Reapply the last known stable schema migration or redeploy_previous

constraints.summary: Fail over in dependency-ordered stages, not all at once
constraints.scope: Control plane and analytics service failover sequence from PDX-01 to secondary DC
constraints.rollback: fail back the last moved service group to PDX-01 if dependencies break

constraints.summary: Pause between stages until error rate and latency recover
constraints.scope: Each service group cutover in the control plane and analytics stack
constraints.rollback: route traffic back to the previous DC for the impacted service group

constraints.summary: Use traffic-shift rollback for every service cutover
constraints.scope: DNS, load balancer, and routing changes moving control plane traffic to secondary DC
constraints.rollback: restore previous routing weights or DNS targets to PDX-01

constraints.summary: Avoid additional cutovers during incident escalation windows
constraints.scope: Any non-emergency follow-on deploys or retries during the failover
constraints.rollback: defer the next cutover step until the window closes

constraints.summary: Rotate any PDX-01-bound credentials before/at cutover
constraints.scope: Secrets, certs, tokens, and service accounts used by control plane and analytics services with primary residency or issuance in PDX-01
constraints.rollback: revoke newly issued credentials and restore prior secret set only if PDX-01 remains trusted; otherwise redeploy_previous

constraints.summary: Preserve audit logs during migration and failover
constraints.scope: Control plane auth, admin actions, config changes, and analytics ingestion/query audit trails during all migration steps
constraints.rollback: pause migration, restore log forwarding to both DCs, and replay buffered events from source of truth

constraints.summary: Review any externally visible auth or trust changes
constraints.scope: Customer-facing dashboard/API auth endpoints, TLS termination, signing keys, and trust anchors that may change during failover
constraints.rollback: redeploy_previous

constraints.summary: Notify customers before any visible auth or access change
constraints.scope: Any customer/partner-visible change to login, API auth, certificates, or endpoint behavior during control plane failover
constraints.rollback: delay cutover until notice window is satisfied or revert to prior externally visible behavior

constraints.summary: Notify customers before any control plane disruption
constraints.scope: Dashboard, API, terraform-provider, and analytics customer-facing availability
constraints.rollback: retract_notice_and_send_followup_explaining_service_restoration

constraints.summary: Post rollout status updates during customer-visible degradation
constraints.scope: All phases of the PDX-01 control plane and analytics failover
constraints.rollback: issue_status_update_with_current_state_and_next_checkin_time

constraints.summary: Have named escalation owner for customer incidents during failover
constraints.scope: Dashboard, API, analytics, and terraform-provider customer escalations
constraints.rollback: reassign_escalations_to_primary_incident_channel

constraints.summary: Do not start failover during launch windows or major events
constraints.scope: Any customer-visible control plane or analytics traffic shift
constraints.rollback: delay_failover_until_next_safe_window

constraints.summary: Support must be briefed before customer-facing changes begin
constraints.scope: Support handling for dashboard, API, and analytics user tickets
constraints.rollback: send_support_war_room_update_and_resend_briefing

constraints.summary: Keep old API endpoint live until clients are migrated
constraints.scope: dashboard, public API, terraform-provider, analytics query API
constraints.rollback: redeploy_previous

constraints.summary: Ship a compatibility shim for control-plane API routing
constraints.scope: API gateway / service discovery during failover
constraints.rollback: disable shim and route traffic back to primary mappings

constraints.summary: Run cutover only after failover smoke tests pass in secondary DC
constraints.scope: control plane API, dashboard auth, terraform-provider, analytics ingest/query
constraints.rollback: redeploy_previous

constraints.summary: Hold rollback path to PDX-01 config until secondary is stable
constraints.scope: deployment orchestration and service routing for control plane
constraints.rollback: revert routing to PDX-01 primary mappings

steps.action: Open incident war room, assign named incident manager, support lead, and comms owner; start customer/partner notice and internal status updates.
steps.rollback: Reassign escalations to the primary incident channel and send follow-up status correcting the incident state.
steps.observability: Incident channel active, stakeholder acknowledgements, customer notice sent, status page updated.

steps.action: Inventory PDX-01-bound secrets/certs/tokens and approve a rotation plan for any externally visible auth or trust changes.
steps.rollback: Revoke newly issued credentials and restore the prior secret set only if still trusted; otherwise redeploy_previous.
steps.observability: Approved secret inventory, rotation plan signed off, list of affected services and trust artifacts.

steps.action: Verify secondary DC configuration parity, dependencies, and runbook order for the control plane and analytics services; identify any PDX-01-only state.
steps.rollback: Revert planning changes and restore prior routing assumptions.
steps.observability: Parity checklist complete, dependency graph validated, gaps/risk exceptions logged.

steps.action: Freeze schema changes for migrated datastores and confirm the cutover occurs within the permitted change window.
steps.rollback: Reapply the last known stable schema migration or redeploy_previous.
steps.observability: Schema migration lock active, no pending DDL, change window compliance recorded.

steps.action: Bring up secondary control-plane and analytics services in dependency order, including compatibility shim and API backward-compatibility checks.
steps.rollback: Redeploy the control-plane services back to PDX-01 and restore prior routing.
steps.observability: Secondary service health, API contract checks, startup logs, dependency readiness, shim validation.

steps.action: Validate secondary read/write capability for control-plane state and verify failover smoke tests for dashboard, API, terraform-provider, and analytics paths.
steps.rollback: Redeploy_previous and revert routing to PDX-01 primary mappings.
steps.observability: Smoke test pass/fail, read/write success, 5xx rate, auth success, query/ingest success.

steps.action: Fail over replication for analytics and control-plane state to secondary, keeping dual-write active while replication lag remains within bounds.
steps.rollback: Stop secondary writes and resume single-writer mode in PDX-01.
steps.observability: Replication lag, backlog depth, replay progress, storage IOPS, audit-log delivery loss.

steps.action: Shift writer role and traffic routing for control-plane services to secondary in a dependency-ordered staged cutover, pausing after each stage until stable.
steps.rollback: Fail back the last moved service group to PDX-01 and restore previous routing weights/DNS targets.
steps.observability: Per-stage error rate, p95 latency, control-plane 5xx, routing convergence, customer-visible availability.

steps.action: Complete customer-facing auth, TLS, and endpoint cutover for dashboard, API, terraform-provider, and analytics query endpoints after secondary is proven live.
steps.rollback: redeploy_previous
steps.observability: Certificate/trust change success, auth failures, endpoint reachability, audit logs, customer ticket volume.

steps.action: Confirm customer communications, support briefing, and rollout status updates are current for the visible degradation and final cutover state.
steps.rollback: Send support war room update and resend briefing; retract notice only if required by rollback.
steps.observability: Support acknowledgement, status updates posted, customer notice delivery, escalation queue health.

steps.action: Hold the legacy PDX-01 rollback path and preserve old primary-side tables/volumes until the quiet period expires.
steps.rollback: Retain old tables/volumes and re-enable access if rollback is needed.
steps.observability: No rollback usage, data consistency checks, storage retention status.

steps.action: Declare incident, name the incident manager, brief support, send customer notice, and publish the first status update before any customer-visible change.
steps.rollback: Reassign escalations to the primary incident channel and send a follow-up restoration notice.
steps.observability: Incident channel ownership, support acknowledgement, customer notice delivery, status page update timestamps.

steps.action: Approve the failover plan, freeze schema changes, and inventory any PDX-01-bound secrets, certs, tokens, and trust anchors that may change during cutover.
steps.rollback: Reapply the last known stable schema migration or redeploy_previous; revoke any newly issued credentials.
steps.observability: Security approval, inventory completeness, schema change freeze confirmation, secret rotation plan status.

steps.action: Bring up and validate the secondary-datacenter control-plane and analytics stack in dependency order without shifting customer traffic.
steps.rollback: Redeploy the moved control-plane services back to PDX-01 and restore prior routing.
steps.observability: Per-service health, dependency readiness, deployment success, saturation, and any PDX-01-only dependency failures.

steps.action: Validate code, config, storage consumers, and read/write behavior in secondary DC using smoke tests and compatibility checks.
steps.rollback: Revert routing to PDX-01 and redeploy previous binaries in the secondary DC.
steps.observability: Smoke test pass rate, API contract compatibility, datastore read/write success, shim behavior, control-plane 5xx rate.

steps.action: Fail over replication for analytics and configuration state, then confirm secondary replication catch-up before any write traffic shift.
steps.rollback: Repoint analytics services back to PDX-01 primary and resume from the preserved lagging replica.
steps.observability: Replication lag, backlog drain rate, caught-up status, replay errors, and analytics ingestion continuity.

steps.action: Rotate or reissue any PDX-01-bound credentials and validate audit-log delivery to both datacenters before cutover.
steps.rollback: Pause migration, restore log forwarding to both DCs, and replay buffered events from the source of truth.
steps.observability: Secret rotation success, certificate propagation, audit log loss, auth failures, and trust-anchor consistency.

steps.action: Cut over the compatibility shim and service-discovery mappings in secondary DC, keeping old API shapes available.
steps.rollback: Disable the shim and route traffic back to primary mappings.
steps.observability: Shim validation results, endpoint compatibility, auth success, routing correctness, and customer-facing error rates.

steps.action: Shift a small, dependency-ordered slice of control-plane traffic to secondary DC while keeping PDX-01 as the writer until read/write parity is confirmed.
steps.rollback: Restore previous routing weights or DNS targets to PDX-01 for the impacted service group.
steps.observability: Per-service error rate, p95 latency, routing health, write-path success, and dependency-specific degradation.

steps.action: Enable dual-write for configuration and analytics state during the overlap window, then verify replication lag stays within bounds.
steps.rollback: Stop secondary writes and resume single-writer mode in PDX-01.
steps.observability: Replication lag, write divergence, conflict rate, ingestion latency, and config consistency checks.

steps.action: Flip writer authority to secondary only after secondary read/write validation and stable dual-write behavior are confirmed.
steps.rollback: Fail back writer role to PDX-01 and disable secondary write traffic.
steps.observability: Writer election status, write acknowledgements, stale-read rate, and cross-DC consistency.

steps.action: Continue staged service-group cutovers with pauses between each stage until each stage is stable and the control plane remains within SLOs.
steps.rollback: Fail back the last moved service group to PDX-01 if dependencies break.
steps.observability: Stage-by-stage error rate, latency, dependency health, customer tickets, and rollback frequency.

steps.action: Hold PDX-01-specific storage objects and decommissioning actions in place; do not delete old tables or volumes until the quiet period is complete.
steps.rollback: Retain old tables/volumes and re-enable access if rollback is needed.
steps.observability: Quiet-period duration, any rollback requests, access attempts to legacy storage, and storage usage drift.

steps.action: Inventory current PDX-01-dependent services, dependencies, secrets, and customer-visible auth/endpoints; confirm secondary capacity and identify any hidden PDX-01-only state.
steps.rollback: Revert to the pre-migration service and dependency inventory snapshot
steps.observability: Dependency gaps, unknown PDX-01-only state, secret inventory completeness, capacity headroom

steps.action: Prepare secondary DC by deploying/patching code, config, schemas, replication, log forwarding, and credential rotation plan in parallel where safe.
steps.rollback: Redeploy previous binaries/config in the secondary DC and revert any schema changes
steps.observability: Service readiness, schema migration status, replication health, audit log delivery, secret rotation readiness

steps.action: Validate secondary read/write capability for control-plane state and analytics datastores, including replication catch-up and smoke tests for API, dashboard, terraform-provider, ingest/query paths.
steps.rollback: Fail writer role back to PDX-01 and stop secondary write traffic
steps.observability: Replication lag, read/write success, smoke test pass rate, storage IOPS, analytics ingestion freshness

steps.action: Install compatibility shim and keep API contracts backward-compatible while secondary remains the serving target candidate.
steps.rollback: Disable shim and restore primary mappings
steps.observability: Request/response compatibility, routing correctness, error rate on dashboard/API/terraform-provider/query endpoints

steps.action: Complete security prerequisites: approve secret rotation plan, rotate PDX-01-bound credentials, preserve audit log delivery, and verify externally visible auth/trust changes are ready.
steps.rollback: Revoke newly issued credentials and restore prior secret set if still trusted; otherwise redeploy_previous
steps.observability: Secret rotation success, cert/token validity, audit log loss rate, auth endpoint behavior

steps.action: Notify support and customers, assign incident owner, and publish the rollout status plan before any customer-visible disruption.
steps.rollback: Retract notice and send follow-up restoration notice
steps.observability: Notification delivery, support acknowledgment, incident ownership assignment, customer escalation volume

steps.action: Move analytics replication/ingestion primary handling to secondary and confirm no data loss while maintaining dual-write/replication constraints.
steps.rollback: Repoint analytics services back to PDX-01 primary and resume from preserved lagging replica
steps.observability: Replication catch-up, lag < 60s, ingest continuity, query freshness, storage IOPS

steps.action: Fail over control-plane service groups in dependency order, starting with lowest-level dependencies and then customer-facing APIs/dashboard/terraform-provider, using traffic-shift rollback for each group.
steps.rollback: Fail back the last moved service group to PDX-01 and restore previous routing weights/DNS targets
steps.observability: Per-group error rate, p95 latency, 5xx rate, dependency breakage, control-plane reachability

steps.action: Run post-cutover stabilization checks and keep PDX-01 as fallback until secondary proves sustained health; monitor rollout metrics and customer-visible degradation.
steps.rollback: Route traffic back to the previous DC for the impacted service group and re-enable PDX-01 primary mappings
steps.observability: Control-plane 5xx, latency, dashboard/API availability, analytics freshness, audit log continuity

steps.action: Convene the incident command path: assign named incident manager, brief support, send customer notice, and establish comms/status cadence for the failover.
steps.rollback: reassign_escalations_to_primary_incident_channel
steps.observability: Incident ownership confirmed, support acknowledged, customer notice sent, status-update channel active

steps.action: Freeze schema changes on migrated control-plane and analytics datastores, and obtain security review for any externally visible auth or trust changes.
steps.rollback: Reapply the last known stable schema migration or redeploy_previous
steps.observability: No schema deploys in flight; auth/trust change review approved

steps.action: Inventory and prepare rotation for all PDX-01-bound credentials, and preserve audit-log forwarding to both datacenters during migration.
steps.rollback: revoke newly issued credentials and restore prior secret set only if PDX-01 remains trusted; otherwise redeploy_previous
steps.observability: Secret inventory complete, rotation plan approved, audit-log delivery loss below 0.1%

steps.action: Bring up the secondary-datacenter control-plane and analytics stack from runbooks, including any compatibility shim and dependency prerequisites, without changing customer traffic yet.
steps.rollback: Redeploy the control-plane services back to PDX-01 and restore prior routing
steps.observability: Secondary services healthy, shim validated in secondary DC, no elevated startup errors

steps.action: Validate code/config/storage parity and read-write behavior in secondary, including smoke tests for dashboard API, public API, terraform-provider, and analytics ingest/query paths.
steps.rollback: Revert routing to PDX-01 and redeploy previous binaries in the secondary DC
steps.observability: Parity checks pass, smoke tests pass, control-plane and analytics read/write validation succeeds

steps.action: Catch up analytics replication to secondary and enable controlled dual-write for config and analytics state while monitoring lag and storage pressure.
steps.rollback: Stop secondary writes and resume single-writer mode in PDX-01
steps.observability: Replication lag under 60s, storage IOPS within budget, no audit-log loss

steps.action: Confirm secondary can serve reads and writes for control-plane state, then keep PDX-01 as writer until this validation is green.
steps.rollback: Fail back writer role to PDX-01 and disable secondary write traffic
steps.observability: Secondary read/write validation passes, write paths stable, no data divergence

steps.action: Cut over service groups in dependency order from PDX-01 to secondary using traffic-shift rollback for each group; stop between stages if error rate or latency regresses.
steps.rollback: fail back the last moved service group to PDX-01 if dependencies break
steps.observability: Per-group error rate under 0.1%, p95 latency within baseline+20%, control-plane 5xx under 1%

steps.action: After each staged cutover, hold for soak monitoring before proceeding to the next dependency layer or any final routing flip.
steps.rollback: route traffic back to the previous DC for the impacted service group
steps.observability: 60-minute stability window met for each moved group

steps.action: Flip customer-facing routing and DNS/LB targets to secondary for the control plane and analytics endpoints once the moved stack is stable.
steps.rollback: restore previous routing weights or DNS targets to PDX-01
steps.observability: Customer-visible endpoints resolve to secondary, 5xx remains below threshold, auth and query paths respond normally

steps.action: Keep old API endpoint compatibility live during the post-cutover period and maintain dual-support for migrated clients.
steps.rollback: redeploy_previous
steps.observability: Legacy request shapes still accepted, no client-auth regressions, support ticket volume stable

steps.action: Retain old primary-side tables and volumes during the quiet period, then decommission only after stability is proven and rollback is no longer likely.
steps.rollback: Retain old tables/volumes and re-enable access if rollback is needed
steps.observability: No rollback activity for 48h, replication and audit trails stable, no storage pressure increase
